repeat.pickLines: Pick two {axis, select, x {upright} other {level}} lines to fit between.
repeat.dontFit: {count} of them don't fit: they need {mm} mm.
repeat.onOrigin: That's attached to the origin: repeat a copy of it instead.
repeat.tooMany: That's more than one sketch holds: repeat fewer, or a smaller group.
repeat.held: It's held in place along {axis} by a dimension or relation: use "Set gap" to repeat from where it is, or remove that first.
repeat.noFit: That doesn't fit with the rest of the sketch.
repeat.title: Repeat with even gaps
repeat.description: Copies of the selection, spaced evenly: slats, shelves, pickets.
repeat.drawLines: Draw {axis, select, x {upright} other {level}} lines on both sides of the selection to fill between, or pick another way.
repeat.lengthToFill: Length to fill, from where the selection starts

makeParts.title: Make parts from lines
makeParts.description: Each line becomes a part cut to its length. Change the sketch and the parts follow.
makeParts.add: Add {n, plural, one {# part} other {# parts}}
makeParts.added: Added {n, plural, one {# part} other {# parts}} to {letter} · {assembly}
makeParts.name: Name

grid.aria: Grid: {size}{auto, select, yes { (follows the zoom)} other {}}, snapping {snap, select, yes {on} other {off}}
grid.snapHint: G to switch; hold Alt to place freely.
grid.autoHint: Auto follows the zoom: finer as you zoom in.

rows.lineLength: Line length, or a circle's diameter
rows.esc: Stop drawing, clear the selection, then back to Select
rows.snap: Snap to grid on or off
rows.helpers: Selected shapes to helpers (construction) and back
rows.on: On a line, circle or axis
rows.symmetric: Symmetric (two points or lines, and the line between)
rows.align: Two or more points: line them up level (V: one above the other)
rows.showAll: Show all measurements (and the angles where lines meet)

hints.selectEmpty: Start at the origin (the circle where the axes cross): pick Rectangle (R), click the origin, type 1200x600 and press Enter. Rough drawing is fine too: pin the sizes after.
hints.select: Click to select (Shift for more; double-click for a whole shape), drag to move. A line's middle (▲) is its midpoint: pick two to line them up. X makes helper lines. Click a number to change it.
hints.lineNext: Click the next point, or type a length and press Enter. End on a point to close; Esc to stop.
hints.lineStart: Click where the line starts: the origin, a point, an axis or anywhere.
hints.rectNext: Click the opposite corner, or type width x height (1200x600) and press Enter.
hints.rectStart: Click one corner (the origin is a good start).
hints.circleNext: Click to set the size, or type the diameter and press Enter.
hints.dimStart: Click a grey size to pin it, or pick two things (points, lines, an axis) for the distance or angle between them.
hints.dimOne: Press Enter (or click empty space) for its own size, or click a second thing.
hints.dimSecond: Click a second point or line.
hints.measureOne: Click a second thing for the distance or angle between.
hints.measureAgain: Click something else to measure again.
hints.measureStart: Click a line, circle or point to measure it, or two for the distance or angle between them. Nothing is added to the sketch.

editor.dimConflict: That doesn't fit with the other dimensions. Change or delete one of them first.
editor.dimDriven: This one is worked out from the others. Change one of those, or delete one, to set it directly.
editor.addedReference: Added as a worked-out value (in brackets): the rest already decides it, so it follows them.
editor.cantRelate: Can't make that {relation}: it doesn't fit with the rest.
editor.snapToast: Snap to grid {snap, select, yes {on} other {off}}
editor.cutAs: Cut as {name}: its length follows this line.
editor.helperTitle: A helper: positions the rest, isn't a part, needs no size (X)
editor.noDimsDraw: Use the Dimension tool (D), or select a line and press Dimension.
editor.showAllHint: Every line's length, every circle's size and the angles where lines meet, worked out.
editor.smallScreen: Change any number here or on the drawing. To draw, open the sketch on a larger screen.
editor.statusConflict: These don't agree: {list}. Change or remove one.
editor.statusConflictNone: These don't agree. Change or remove one.
editor.statusDefined: Fully defined: every size is pinned down.
editor.statusMore: {n, plural, one {{n} more dimension or relation} other {{n} more dimensions or relations}} to pin it down. Blue parts can still move.
editor.lengthDriven: length worked out from the rest

canvas.joinFail: Those two points can't be joined: it doesn't fit with the rest.
canvas.axisFail: That point can't go on the axis: it doesn't fit with the rest.

card.emptyText: Draw it roughly, pin the sizes and angles you know, and the rest is worked out.
card.limit: A project holds up to {max} sketches. Delete one to start another.
card.menuEmpty: No sketches yet: draw it roughly, pin the sizes you know, and the rest is worked out.

assembly.cutFrom: {name}: parts here are cut from it
assembly.title: Sketches for {letter} · {name}
assembly.description: A sketch belongs to one assembly: it shows on that assembly's card, and its parts go there.
assembly.none: No sketches in this project yet.
assembly.footnote: Sketches whose lines are parts here show on the card too.
